as_of.description: When the network last published the data in this response.

live.description: False when the network has published nothing new for over 5 minutes; `as_of` says when it last did.

notice.description: Null while the data is live. Otherwise, in plain words: that TransMilenio is not publishing live data, since when, and what this response holds instead.

trip_start_time.description: `HH:MM:SS` the trip was scheduled to start.

stop_id.description: The stop the vehicle is at or heading to.

reported_at.description: When the vehicle reported this position, ISO 8601.

distance_m.description: Metres from the point searched around; null without one.

as_of.description: When the network last published the data in this response.

live.description: False when the network has published nothing new for over 5 minutes; `as_of` says when it last did.

notice.description: Null while the data is live. Otherwise, in plain words: that TransMilenio is not publishing live data, since when, and what this response holds instead.

found.description: False for an id the network does not publish.

predicted_at.description: When the vehicle is expected at the stop, ISO 8601 `-05:00`.

basis.description: `predicted` when the network predicts this stop itself; `estimated` from the last stop the vehicle reported plus the scheduled running time from there; `scheduled` from the timetable, when the live data is not arriving (`live: false`).

delay_seconds.description: Seconds behind (positive) or ahead of (negative) the timetable.
